name: tapestry-spec
description: Quint formal specifications for Tapestry's load-bearing invariants (INV-1 pilot: contrib/luzanikita-formal-spec/consortium).

scripts.typecheck: quint typecheck consortium/shared.qnt && quint typecheck consortium/compliant.qnt && quint typecheck consortium/compliant_test.qnt && quint typecheck consortium/leaky.qnt
scripts.run:compliant: quint run --invariant=no_raw_data_crosses --verbosity=1 consortium/compliant.qnt && quint run --invariant=only_cpt_feeds_base --verbosity=1 consortium/compliant.qnt && quint run --invariant=weights_portable --verbosity=1 consortium/compliant.qnt
scripts.spec:check: npm run typecheck && npm run run:compliant && npm run test
